memories.content:
LTX 2.3 Architecture & Control — Key Findings

**Architecture (22B DiT, dual-stream):**
- 14B video stream + 5B audio stream, 48 transformer blocks
- Each block: Self-Attention → Text Cross-Attention → Audio-Visual Cross-Attention → FFN
- 3D-RoPE: channel dim split into C_f (temporal) + C_h (height) + C_w (width); unified spatiotemporal attention, no factorized split
- VAE: 1:192 compression (32×32×8 px/token); patchification moved to VAE input to allow full spatiotemporal self-attention; VAE decoder does final denoising step in pixel space (recovers hair/edges/text without upscaler)
- Text: Gemma 3 12B + 4× larger connector + "thinking tokens" (learnable tokens that aggregate global context before DiT cross-attention)

**STG (Spatiotemporal Skip Guidance) — training-free:**
- Creates implicit weak model by skipping Block 28 or 29 (final layers)
- STG-R: skip entire residual block; STG-A: replace attention matrix A with identity (SA'=IV)
- s_stg 1.0–1.5: stabilizes rigid structures, kills flicker; 0.5–0.8: more motion freedom
- ComfyUI params: skip_blocks, perturb_attn (bool), rescale (0–1, prevents saturation), modality_scale (AV sync)

**IC-LoRA (AVControl) — attention injection:**
- Reference tokens injected directly into self-attention (NOT channel concat — avoids VAE retraining)
- Negative temporal RoPE for reference tokens (t_ref < 0), target positive — prevents bleed
- attention_strength (0–1): scales cross-attention scores between target latents and reference tokens
- Modalities: Canny, Depth (DWPose), Pose, Motion Track, Union Control (all combined)
- Never run multiple IC-LoRA groups simultaneously (VRAM explosion)

**ControlNet Preprocessing:**
- Depth static: Depth Anything V2 (213ms/frame)
- Depth video: Video Depth Anything (temporal consistency, key-frame referencing)
- Pose: DWPose ONNX/TorchScript (GPU); CPU is prohibitively slow
- Edge: PiDiNet (soft-edge) or AnyLine (complex textures); Canny is noise-sensitive
- Normals: Normal DSINE; use Mask Blur 1–5 to smooth jagged edges

Auto-formatter PostToolUse hook — configured in gionodes project.

scripts_claude/format_hook.sh triggers on Edit|Write|MultiEdit:
- .py → .venv/bin/python -m black --quiet
- .md → npx prettier --write --log-level silent
- .json → npx prettier (skips */workflows/* — managed by clean_workflow.py)
- All failures silenced (|| true), never blocks Claude

scripts_claude/strip_mcp_hook.sh strips MCP response noise on PostToolUse:
- NotebookLM: keeps only answer + conversation_id (strips sources/citations/references)
- Perplexity: strips Citations block and inline [1][2] markers
- Exit 2 + stdout replaces what Claude sees

Pattern for any project: PostToolUse hook on Edit|Write|MultiEdit in .claude/settings.json, run formatter silently, always exit 0.

delice_gen rewrite plan (No ComfyUI). Full reference: docs/library_plan.md

GOAL: Rebuild delice_gen as a zero-ComfyUI Python library for LTX 2.3 video generation + preprocessing.

PHASE 1 SCOPE: preprocessing + LTX i2v + SAM2/SAM3 masking.

LIBRARY STACK (final decisions):
- Background: rembg (isnet-general-use/u2net_human_seg); RMBG-2.0 via transformers AutoModel as secondary
- Depth: transformers pipeline for Depth Anything V2 (DA-v2 not in controlnet-aux); controlnet-aux MidasDetector/ZoeDetector as alternatives
- Pose: controlnet-aux + easy-dwpose -> DWposeDetector; draw utils copied from ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper/unianimate/dwpose/util.py
- Detection: BBoxDetector/SegmDetector abstraction (backend-agnostic); YOLO default (ultralytics, adapted from subcore.py); GroundingDINO optional text-prompted; SEG namedtuple from subcore.py
- SAM2+SAM3: BOTH via `from ultralytics import SAM` — sam2_b.pt (bbox+video propagation) and sam3.pt (text prompts "person","hand" no bbox needed). SAM3 = official Meta release facebookresearch/sam3, HF facebook/sam3
- LTX 2.3: diffusers LTXImageToVideoPipeline; IC-LoRA via pipe.load_lora_weights(); STG via register_forward_hook on pipe.transformer.transformer_blocks[i].attn1
- Qwen2.5-VL, DiffSynth WAN, Sapiens: Phase 2 deferred

CODE TO COPY (not import):
- draw utils: ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper/unianimate/dwpose/util.py (pure math ~200 lines)
- pyramid blending: ComfyUI-LTXVideo/pyramid_blending.py
- feather mask: 10S-Comfy-nodes/latent_likeness_guide.py
- detection template: ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack/modules/subcore.py (copy+strip folder_paths+whitelist)

CODE TO PORT (rewrite against diffusers):
- delice_gen/models/ltx/attention.py -> STG/APG hooks
- delice_gen/models/ltx/ic_lora.py -> IC-LoRA guide encoding
- delice_gen/preprocessing/masking.py -> pure tensor ops

KEY INSIGHT: ultralytics covers YOLO detection + SAM/SAM2/SAM3 segmentation in one package.
